title: Potatoverse Science Model Testing Protocol
purpose: Make the science wing progressively more rigorous without allowing analogies, decorative equations, recovered fragments or later formalizations to drift into unsupported physical claims. Every serious theory should read like an inspectable research programme: a reader should be able to tell what the model is, what the equations mean, what assumptions they require, what is measurable, what competing explanation exists and what result would count against the model.

required_elements: mathematical or physical object being modeled
current maturity and strongest unresolved limitation
abstract_contract.style_rule: An abstract should summarize a model rather than advertise it. Avoid claims of unification, explanation, prediction or evidence unless the record identifies the explicit mechanism, comparison baseline and supporting result.
abstract_contract.length_guidance: Prefer one dense paragraph or 120-250 words for flagship theory records; shorter archaeology records may use 60-150 words.
abstract_contract.anti_pattern: Do not use an abstract as a list of motifs, famous theories or symbolic correspondences.

equation_annotation_contract.rule: An equation is not made more scientific by being complicated. If symbols, dimensions, state space and observable meaning are missing, retain it as a schematic expression rather than promoting it to a physical law.

tests.name: provenance
tests.question: Can the exact equation or statement be tied to a dated source?
tests.fail_action: mark unrecovered or later-formalized; never attribute as verbatim Tim.

tests.name: variable-definition
tests.question: Does every symbol have a defined meaning and mathematical type?

tests.name: units
tests.question: Are physical dimensions/units stated and consistent?
tests.fail_action: not eligible as a physical equation.

tests.name: domain
tests.question: What space does the model act on: physical spacetime, graph, probability manifold, state space, chronology, symbolic ontology?
tests.fail_action: do not compare results across domains as if identical.

tests.name: well-posedness
tests.question: Given admissible initial/boundary data, is the model expected to have a meaningful solution and are obvious ghost, instability, singularity or nonuniqueness problems identified?
tests.fail_action: classify as ansatz/research sketch until the issue is resolved.

tests.name: dynamics
tests.question: What determines evolution or transition?
tests.fail_action: classify as static taxonomy/geometry rather than dynamics.

tests.name: identifiability
tests.question: Could the proposed parameters or internal components in principle be distinguished from the available observables?
tests.fail_action: state the degeneracy and specify additional measurements or interventions needed.

tests.name: observability
tests.question: What quantity could actually be measured or computed?

tests.name: limiting-cases
tests.question: Does the proposal reduce to a known simpler theory in a declared parameter limit?
tests.fail_action: record missing correspondence limit; do not claim extension of the baseline theory.

tests.name: novelty
tests.question: What does this model explain, compress or predict beyond existing theories?
tests.fail_action: retain as analogy, educational model, ontology or reframing.

tests.name: falsifiability
tests.question: What outcome would count against the model?
tests.fail_action: do not describe as empirical scientific theory.

tests.name: baseline
tests.question: What established theory already explains the phenomenon?
tests.fail_action: compare against baseline before invoking new force, field or dimension.

tests.name: model-selection
tests.question: Does added complexity improve predictive performance enough to justify extra parameters?
tests.fail_action: penalize complexity using held-out performance, information criteria or Bayesian evidence where applicable.

tests.name: overfitting
tests.question: Were parameters chosen after seeing the target pattern?
tests.fail_action: label exploratory and require out-of-sample test.

tests.name: category-boundary
tests.question: Is a mathematical analogy being mistaken for physical identity?
tests.fail_action: split the records and add an explicit boundary note.

components.C: consistency with stated symmetries and constraints

theory_completeness_vector.scoring: Each component may be scored 0-4 with written justification. Never collapse the vector into one authoritative truth score; the purpose is to expose where a model is strong or weak.
theory_completeness_vector.promotion_rule: A record should not be presented publicly as a serious empirical candidate merely because its algebra is sophisticated. The O, F and B components must also be nontrivial.

maturity_ladder.name: metaphor
maturity_ladder.criterion: No mathematical object or empirical claim required.

maturity_ladder.name: defined conceptual model
maturity_ladder.criterion: Objects, relations and scope are explicit.

maturity_ladder.name: mathematical toy model
maturity_ladder.criterion: Equations and variables are defined and internally calculable.

maturity_ladder.name: calibrated model
maturity_ladder.criterion: Parameters can be estimated from data and uncertainty is represented.

maturity_ladder.name: predeclared discriminating prediction
maturity_ladder.criterion: A quantitative result distinguishes the model from named baselines before the data are inspected.

maturity_ladder.name: independently replicated theory
maturity_ladder.criterion: Independent evidence repeatedly supports its distinctive predictions and known alternatives have been seriously compared.

door_xi.current: Xi/Xi_c is a schematic critical-threshold model.
missing: units or proof it is dimensionless
door_xi.next: Construct Xi from dimensionless control variables in one domain first and specify hysteresis/transition statistics before considering a physical fifth-dimensional interpretation.

radion_door.current: phi(x)=M_* ln(R/R_0) is a radion-inspired speculative model.
radion_door.next: Build a conventional Kaluza-Klein toy model first and show exactly where the Timic interpretation enters.

starchforce.current: The strongest scientifically usable version is storage/release dynamics rather than an unsupported fifth fundamental force.
starchforce.next: Develop biological, informational and economic storage models separately; only propose a fundamental force if a new measurable force law and anomaly exist.

field_of_life.current: Book-derived metaphor comparing Potato to an excitation in a field of life.
field_of_life.next: Prefer reaction-diffusion, ecological, developmental or network fields for life-pattern modeling before quantum-field terminology.

red_blue.next: Test as a two-variable dynamical system or control tradeoff, such as exploration versus exploitation, rather than a physical color/frequency claim.

spiral.current: The logarithmic spiral is mathematically well defined and now has exact derived pitch, curvature, arc-length and area laws; its physical interpretation remains domain dependent.
missing: declared dataset and coordinate extraction method for each empirical use
out-of-sample comparison with Archimedean, power-law and spline alternatives
spiral.next: Treat geometry as a fitted hypothesis with residuals and model comparison rather than a visual motif.

merkaba_counter_rotation.current: Dynamic counter-rotation/alignment of opposites around a still center.
merkaba_counter_rotation.next: Start with a two-oscillator or rigid-body toy model and state which project property it represents.

evidence_labels.B: project formalism clearly documented but later than originating intuition

publication_rule: Every public science page should make clear whether displayed mathematics is Tim-authored/recovered, archive-generated, or established external mathematics, and flagship models should expose their abstract, equation context, maturity level, observables and failure conditions before interpretive symbolism.
research_note_2026_09_11: Rigor upgrade: the archive now evaluates theories by whether they can be solved, estimated, compared and potentially rejected, not by equation count or the number of external theories named.
